topic: Which invalid lines the app drops for the user
detail: SP-054's 'Drop invalid lines' only reverts lines the draft adds or changes, and never: a line the applied revision already has, a line in a conflict between two spaces (duplicate name, org, prefix, tenant or root bound twice, an isolated root inside another job's), or a binding the applied revision has in any space (moved or renamed). Those are marked with 'fix this in the draft' and block Apply. Options: (a) keep this; (b) let the user pick a side or edit the draft in the app. Recommendation: (a), with (b) as a later Setup feature.
